title: Vietnamese Pho with Sausage
description: A flavorful and gluten-free Vietnamese Pho recipe featuring rich, Polish sausage and pho.
instructions: Bring the pho to a boil in a large pot over medium-high heat.
Reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the sliced onion and ginger to the pot and cook for an additional 5 minutes.
Slice the Polish sausage into 1/4-inch thick rounds and add to the pot.
Cook the Vietnamese noodles according to the package instructions and set aside.
To assemble the pho, place some noodles into a bowl, then add slices of sausage and the cooked onion and ginger.
Pour the hot pho over the top and add a spoonful of fish sauce, soy sauce, and hoisin sauce.
Garnish with bean sprouts, fresh cilantro, and a sprinkle of black pepper.
Optional: Add sliced fresh herbs like basil or mint for added flavor and color.
